title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: which withdrawals of a reconciled cycle count toward the allowance
content:
## Scope

This rule applies to a Savings & Money Market Accounts account from which overdraft protection transfers have been made, when the excess withdrawal fees of a statement cycle are reconciled. It fixes how many of that cycle's withdrawals count toward the withdrawal allowance.

## Policy clause

1. The withdrawals that count are the cycle's withdrawals whose channel is on the tier's list of channels that count toward the allowance, taken channel by channel: online transfer, mobile app transfer, telephone banking transfer, ACH debit, money market check and domestic wire, each only when the tier lists it.
2. To these are added the cycle's overdraft protection transfers, whichever checking account they covered, when the tier's "overdraft transfers count" setting is yes.
3. Branch withdrawals, ATM withdrawals and internal transfers never count.
4. The number that counts is the total of all the withdrawals so taken.

## Basis of decision

- **Authority.** Channels, counterparties and statement cycles are read from the savings account's transaction record; the channel list and the overdraft setting are those of the account's tier.
- **Object correlation.** All of the cycle's overdraft protection transfers are taken, whichever checking account each one covered.

## Channel checklist

| Channel of the withdrawal | Counts when |
|---|---|
| online transfer | the tier lists it |
| mobile app transfer | the tier lists it |
| telephone banking transfer | the tier lists it |
| ACH debit | the tier lists it |
| money market check | the tier lists it |
| domestic wire | the tier lists it |
| overdraft protection transfer, whichever checking account it covered | the tier's overdraft setting is yes |
| branch, ATM, internal transfer | never |

## Worked case (hypothetical tier and cycle)

Assume, for illustration only, a tier that lists every channel above except money market check, and whose overdraft setting is yes. The cycle contains:

| Withdrawals in the cycle | Number | Count toward the allowance |
|---|---|---|
| online transfers | 3 | 3 |
| mobile app transfer | 1 | 1 |
| ACH debits | 2 | 2 |
| money market check | 1 | 0, not listed by this tier |
| ATM withdrawals | 2 | 0 |
| branch withdrawal | 1 | 0 |
| internal transfer | 1 | 0 |
| overdraft protection transfers, one to each of two checking accounts | 2 | 2 |

The number that counts is the total of 3, 1, 2 and 2, which is 8.

## Points of judgement

**The same cycle had an internal transfer that opened a certificate of deposit. Does it count?** No; internal transfers never count.

**On a tier whose overdraft setting is no, do overdraft protection transfers count?** No; they are added only when the setting is yes.
